返り討ち: having the tables turned on someone (e.g. by a challenger); being beaten at one's own game
違和: incongruity (違和感: a sense that something is off)
揺れる: to become unstable; to become unsettled; to be shaken; to waver
齎す: to bring about; to cause; to produce (e.g. results)
犯す: to risk; to brave (冒す: 危険を冒す, to brave danger)
二言: double-dealing; double tongue; going back on what one has said
収める: to settle (事を収める: to settle a matter)
加える: to inflict (damage); to deal; to give
流石: as one would expect; just as you'd expect (from); just like (someone)
鳴らす: to be popular; to be esteemed; to be reputed
気取り: posing as; behaving as; acting like; pretending to be
分かれる: to separate; to split; to divide
